_note: Every `cfr` string @hazmat/engine emits (TWO-CLICK-READER-PLAN TC0.5, D-TC10). `cfr` and `mustSay` are written by a person: what the engine cites, and the words its eCFR paragraph must contain for the engine's use of it to be right. Everything else is written by import/citationsBuild.ts from eCFR at `ecfrDate` — run it after any change. The census (@hazmat/golden citationCensus.test.ts) holds the engine to this list.

internal.cfr: internal: Table 1 out of scope (plan D4-revised / D2)
internal.why: The engine refuses a Table 1 load (§172.504(e) Table 1) rather than computing it; this names the plan decision, not a CFR paragraph. D-TC13's catalogue words it for the screen.
A line whose class the dataset cannot resolve is withheld, never guessed; a plan decision, not a CFR paragraph.

internal.cfr: internal: explosives out of scope (plan D4-revised / D2)
internal.why: Explosives are refused rather than computed; a plan decision, not a CFR paragraph.

A provisional dataset withholds every placard determination rather than computing one from unattested data; a plan decision, not a CFR paragraph. Reached only on a provisional dataset, so the sweep (the shipped LATEST) never emits it.
